# Maintainx

MaintainX is a cloud-based computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) that helps organizations centralize maintenance data, communication, and workflows.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/maintainx/.

## Actions

- **Create Work Order**: This tool creates a new work order in maintainx.
- **Create Work Order Comment**: This tool creates a new comment on an existing work order in maintainx.
- **Create Work Request Portal**: Creates a new work request portal in maintainx.
- **Find Entity** (read-only): A tool to search and find specific entities within maintainx by specified fields.
- **List Assets** (read-only): This tool allows users to retrieve a list of all assets in their organization.
- **List Categories** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all categories in your maintainx organization.
- **List Locations** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all available locations in the organization's maintainx account.
- **List Teams** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all teams in your maintainx organization.
- **List Work Orders** (read-only): Action to list work orders from maintainx.
- **Update Work Order**: This tool allows users to update an existing work order in maintainx by modifying specific attributes without affecting other unchanged…
- **Update Work Order Status**: This tool allows users to update the status of a specific work order in maintainx.
